meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of crimes and arrests that police agencies reported to the FBI, kept for research and marketing planning. An arrest says an officer took someone into custody, not that a charge was filed or proved. Whether and how to defend a charge, and every deadline, are for the person's own counsel.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

records.text: United States, 2025: agencies covering 95.7% of residents reported offenses and 93.1% reported arrests. They reported 1,097,449 violent crimes and 5,158,467 property crimes, and 737,264 DUI arrests among 7,202,161 arrests (859,572 for drug abuse violations). 2021-2025: 5,747,500 violent crimes, 28,219,846 property crimes, 3,473,335 DUI arrests. FBI Crime Data Explorer as of 2026-10-15; a month an agency did not report is not counted.
records.note: The sum of the 50 states and DC; check.py compares it with the FBI's own national rate.
